text:
maria: Quick Q — for the upcoming audit: what exactly is available in our audit logs? Need 'who did what' exports for a compliance review. Any easy export?

devon: We capture: actor_id (hashed), actor_email (redacted), action, resource_type, resource_id, timestamp, ip, user_agent, request_id, org_id, outcome (success/failure), change_summary. :+1:

ashok: Exports available via Console -> Org -> Audit Logs (CSV/NDJSON) or via internal CLI:
```
redwoodctl audit export --org redwood --start 2024-04-01 --end 2024-04-14 \
  --format ndjson --s3 s3://redwood-audit/exports/2024-04/ --redact-pii
```
Console export is limited to 90 days, CLI can pull ranges and writes to S3.

maria: Nice. Are emails fully redacted? Compliance wants "who" mapped to user names — can we map actor_id -> display name in the export?

devon: We hash emails at rest; exports include actor_id + display_name only if requester has directory.read scope. For compliance, file a ticket to #sec-requests with justification and target user list, we can produce mapping CSV.

irene: Retention is 365 days by default for hosted orgs. For Dedicated/Private customers it's configurable in the deployment manifest. Longer retention can be set via contract addendum.

maria: What's the export schema? Sample line?

audit-bot: sample_export.ndjson (1 record):
{"timestamp":"2024-04-14T12:03:22Z","actor_id":"u_*****","actor_email":"redacted","actor_display":"devon","action":"model.deploy","resource_type":"deployment","resource_id":"dep-1234","ip":"3.12.45.6","user_agent":"redwood/1.2.0","request_id":"req-9a8b","outcome":"success","change_summary":"scaled from 2->4"}

ashok: Note: for privacy we replace full IP in exports with /redacted for EU orgs; full IP only available to ops-soc with approved ticket.

maria: If I need a one-off export for a set of requests (IDs), what's the process?

devon: Send gist with request_ids + time range to #sec-requests and ping me. We'll schedule an export, create sanitized NDJSON, put in S3, and attach pre-signed link. Audit-bot will log who requested the export.

maria: perfect. filing the ticket now. Thanks all :raised_hands:

devon: np :eyes:
